**Uno – Quick‑Start Rules** | Section | What Happens | |---------|--------------| | **Goal** | Be the first player to score 500 points (or whatever you decide). Points are earned by being the first to finish a round and by collecting cards left in opponents’ hands. | | **Setup** | • 108‑card deck (standard Uno deck).
• Each player draws 7 cards.
• Place the remaining deck face‑down as the draw pile.
• Flip the top card of the draw pile to start the discard pile. If it’s an action card, follow its effect immediately. | | **Turn Order** | Players take turns clockwise (unless a direction‑changing card is played). On your turn you may:
1. **Play** one card that matches the color, number, or symbol of the top discard.
2. **Draw** one card from the draw pile if you can’t play. If the drawn card can be played, you may play it immediately.
3. **UNO** – When you have only one card left, shout “UNO!” before the next player takes their turn. If you forget, you must draw two penalty cards when the next player draws. | | **Action Cards** | • **Skip** – Next player loses a turn.
• **Reverse** – Reverses play direction.
• **Draw Two (+2)** – Next player draws two cards and loses a turn.
• **Wild** – Player chooses the new color.
• **Wild Draw Four (+4)** – Player chooses the new color; next player draws four cards and loses a turn. (Can be challenged if the player could have played a different card.) | | **Winning a Round** | The round ends when a player discards all their cards. That player scores points equal to the sum of the values of the cards left in opponents’ hands: numbers = face value, Draw Two/Reverse/Skip = 20, Wild/Wild Draw Four = 50. | | **Scoring** | Add the round score to the winner’s total. First to reach the target score (usually 500) wins the game. | | **Optional Variations** | • **Stacking** – Allow players to stack Draw Two or Wild Draw Four cards instead of drawing.
• **No Challenge** – Wild Draw Four can be played without challenge.
• **House Rules** – e.g., “Draw Two on a Wild” or “Skip on a Reverse.” | **Quick Tips** 1. Keep track of the current color and number; it helps you plan which cards to hold. 2. Use Wild cards strategically to change the color when you’re stuck. 3. Remember to shout “UNO!”—it’s a simple but crucial rule. Enjoy playing!
